facts: Constitution 1.1.0 (specs/constitution.md, approval specs/constitution.approval.json) is adopted for this change; principle 4 permits the activity-refresh audit waiver documented in specs/004-workspace-session-tracking/plan.md:133.

runMigrations in src/db/migrate.ts applies files matching /^\d+_.+\.sql$/ in sorted order, each inside its own BEGIN/COMMIT on a pool client; a new file 018_workspace_tracking.sql is picked up without code changes.
appendAuditEntry in src/util/audit.ts takes a pg Pool; a PoolClient inside a transaction is not assignable to that parameter today.
updateEntity in src/services/entity-service.ts:302 takes a Pool and runs outside any caller transaction; per decision D2 the report never calls it.

Scope is enforced with requireScope(auth, scope) from src/auth/key-service.ts:113, which throws AppError FORBIDDEN; visibility uses auth.allowedVisibility and auth.allowedTypes as in src/services/task-service.ts:158-160.

Service functions return ResultAsync (ServiceResult<T> in src/types/common.ts) built with ResultAsync.fromPromise(async () => {...}, toAppError); neverthrow is ^8.2.0, read values with result.isOk()/_unsafeUnwrap() in tests and .match() in code.
Transactions follow src/services/admin-job-service.ts:769-772: const client = await pool.connect(); BEGIN; queries with FOR UPDATE; COMMIT; ROLLBACK on error; client.release() in finally.

Integration tests use createTestDatabase()/resetTestDatabase()/seedApiKey() from tests/helpers/postgres.ts (pgvector/pgvector:pg17 via testcontainers) and run migrations on start; resetTestDatabase truncates a fixed list that must include every new table.

Server config is one zod schema in src/config.ts; integer settings use z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(N)); each setting is mirrored in docker-compose.yml, .env.example and the README configuration table. No page under docs/ lists environment variables.

ESLint applies typescript-eslint recommendedTypeChecked plus consistent-type-imports and no-floating-promises to src/**/*.ts; require-await is active outside the CLI folders, so an async function must await something.
Installed versions: zod ^3.25.76, pg ^8.16.3, neverthrow ^8.2.0, vitest ^3.2.4, testcontainers ^11.8.1, typescript ^5.9.3.
